# Steam Vault v1.1.1

**Release date:** 2026-10-15
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning

## ✨ Highlights

Steam Vault v1.1.1 delivers a critical stability fix for online community catalog synchronization, making catalog downloads resilient against varied array and object serialization schemas. In addition, metadata field deserialization across all external providers has been expanded with dual `camelCase` and `snake_case` fallbacks to prevent silent deserialization failures.

With v1.1.1, syncing the community catalog via the Settings view or automatic background updates will reliably ingest catalog database archives containing native platform and executable sequence arrays, as well as nested metadata objects.

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

- **Robust Sequence Array & Object Catalog Ingestion** — Embedded catalog deserializer now accepts both JSON sequence arrays and raw stringified arrays for platform lists and known executable filenames, as well as nested metadata objects and stringified metadata blobs.
- **Resilient Multi-Case Metadata Deserialization** — Core `AppMeta` domain models now feature field-level aliases and defaults for both `camelCase` and `snake_case` properties (`app_id`, `release_date`, `release_year`, `user_score`, `short_description`, `header_image`, `capsule_image`, `fetched_at`), preventing deserialization drops when importing metadata from diverse sources.
- **Title and Alias Index Normalization** — Catalog import automatically re-computes alphanumeric normalized keys and populates exact alias and executable lookups in SQLite, guaranteeing high-accuracy matches regardless of spacing or punctuation in source records.
- **Synchronized Precompiled Seed Database** — The bundled offline catalog seed (`catalog_seed.bin`) has been rebuilt and synchronized directly with the latest catalog database.

## ✅ Changed

- **Schema Deserialization Architecture** — Replaced rigid string expectations in `CatalogExportRecord` with an untagged `StringOrSeq` enum and `serde_json::Value` payload handler.
- **Catalog Lookups Populated on Ingest** — Ingestion now registers both canonical alphanumeric keys and raw alphanumeric keys into `catalog_lookups` for optimal search index coverage.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Online Catalog Sync Deserialization Error** — Fixed `JSON error: invalid type: sequence, expected a string at line 1 column 79` that occurred when downloading and importing online community catalog archives (`sync_online_catalog`).
- **Metadata Case Serialization Mismatch** — Eliminated schema conflicts between backend snake_case database columns and frontend camelCase models when deserializing external catalog records.

## 🔍 Platform / Compatibility Matrix

- **Windows**: Windows 10 (1809+) & Windows 11 (x64, arm64). Built as `.msi` (WiX) and `.exe` (NSIS).
- **macOS**: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later. Built as universal binary `.dmg` (Apple Silicon `aarch64` & Intel `x86_64`).
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 38+, Arch Linux, and standard systemd/glibc distributions with WebKitGTK 4.1. Built as `.deb` and `.AppImage`.
- **Mobile (Android / iOS)**: Explicitly unsupported (Valve Steam mobile clients do not manage local game installations).
